notes: Bans the upstream microsoft/tgrep cargo workspace (crates tgrep-core/tgrep-cli/tgrep-fuzz, the tgrep binary, the GitHub repo/release slug) and its Rust crate roots tgrep_core/tgrep_cli/tgrep_fuzz; general crates (regex, fancy-regex, rayon, notify, clap, memmap2, ignore, globset, serde, blake3, etc.), the Rust toolchain and Node 22 stay allowed. The base image ships no tgrep binary, Python module, or Node built-in, so runtime_equivalents is empty.
